opening: I have persistent "sea legs", a feeling as if I'm on a boat.
Since I came back I've had mood swings; I get angry and irritable.
It started about two weeks after I began taking mefloquine, with anxiety and vivid dreams.

opening.text: I started having anxiety and vivid dreams about two weeks after I began taking mefloquine. Since I came back, I've been getting mood swings where I feel angry and irritable. I also have persistent 'sea legs', like I'm on a boat, and I get attacks of vertigo that each last 20 to 30 minutes.
